related.title: Qiskit Ramsey：從 T1 與 T2* 分離純退相位
related.titleEn: Qiskit Ramsey: separate pure dephasing from T1 and T2*
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付半對數衰減圖、平台診斷及重置時間預算。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver a semilog decay plot, plateau diagnosis and reset-time budget. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『Qiskit Ramsey：從 T1 與 T2* 分離純退相位』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付速率分解表、失效例與量測同步條件。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Qiskit Ramsey: separate pure dephasing from T1 and T2*', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver a rate decomposition, invalid example and acquisition-synchronization conditions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：單指數能量鬆弛 P1(t)=exp(−t/T1)；此處假設初態完全激發且熱平衡激發率為零。 使用教學 T1=100 μs、等待t=50 μs；先不加入準備與讀出誤差。 以手算或試算表計算名義式exp(-50/100)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：以log(P1)對時間斜率驗證−1/T1；兩點比值應為exp(−0.5)。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：馬可夫指數模型1/T2=1/(2T1)+1/Tφ；非指數或準靜態雜訊時只是有效參數。 使用合成 T1=100 μs、T2*=80 μs，所有倒數用μs⁻¹。 以手算或試算表計算名義式1/(1/80-1/(2*100))，另開一欄執行獨立核對：將反算的Tφ代回速率總和；再試T2*=250 μs並標記負速率代表模型或量測矛盾。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Single-exponential relaxation P1(t)=exp(−t/T1) assumes full initial excitation and zero equilibrium excitation. Use Teaching T1=100 μs and wait t=50 μs; preparation and readout errors are initially excluded. Evaluate nominal expression exp(-50/100) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check slope−1/T1 in log(P1) versus time; the two-point ratio should be exp(−0.5).

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: The Markov exponential model gives1/T2=1/(2T1)+1/Tφ; for nonexponential or quasistatic noise this is only effective. Use Synthetic T1=100 μs and T2*=80 μs; all rates use μs⁻¹. Evaluate nominal expression 1/(1/80-1/(2*100)) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Substitute recovered Tφ into the rate sum; test T2*=250 μs and flag the negative rate as model or measurement inconsistency.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: IBM 類型讀出：色散位移與失諧尺度
related.titleEn: IBM-style readout: dispersive shift and detuning scale
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付半對數衰減圖、平台診斷及重置時間預算。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver a semilog decay plot, plateau diagnosis and reset-time budget. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『IBM 類型讀出：色散位移與失諧尺度』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付色散近似有效區、符號慣例與待補的非諧性資料。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IBM-style readout: dispersive shift and detuning scale', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver a dispersive-validity region, sign convention and missing anharmonicity data.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：單指數能量鬆弛 P1(t)=exp(−t/T1)；此處假設初態完全激發且熱平衡激發率為零。 使用教學 T1=100 μs、等待t=50 μs；先不加入準備與讀出誤差。 以手算或試算表計算名義式exp(-50/100)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：以log(P1)對時間斜率驗證−1/T1；兩點比值應為exp(−0.5)。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：兩能階近似χ=g²/Δ，以循環頻率一致代入可得χ/2π；真實transmon還含非諧性修正。 使用合成g/2π=50 MHz、Δ/2π=1000 MHz；abs(g/Δ)=0.05。 以手算或試算表計算名義式50**2/1000，另開一欄執行獨立核對：檢查χΔ=g²在兩組相同；另把Δ改50 MHz，標記近似失效而非接受巨大位移。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Single-exponential relaxation P1(t)=exp(−t/T1) assumes full initial excitation and zero equilibrium excitation. Use Teaching T1=100 μs and wait t=50 μs; preparation and readout errors are initially excluded. Evaluate nominal expression exp(-50/100) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check slope−1/T1 in log(P1) versus time; the two-point ratio should be exp(−0.5).

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Two-level approximation χ=g²/Δ yields χ/2π when cyclic frequencies are used consistently; real transmons require anharmonicity corrections. Use Synthetic g/2π=50 MHz and Δ/2π=1000 MHz give abs(g/Δ)=0.05. Evaluate nominal expression 50**2/1000 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check χΔ=g² in both cases; set Δ=50 MHz separately and flag approximation failure rather than accepting a large shift.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
